objects.description: [Axiom](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0001) has used exploits for multiple vulnerabilities including CVE-2014-0322, CVE-2012-4792, CVE-2012-1889, and CVE-2013-3893.(Citation: Cisco Group 72)
